## Overview

anbeda AG is a Swiss solar blog and consulting service focused on DIY photovoltaic installations, balcony solar systems, and renewable energy education.

### Key Facts
- Location: Switzerland
- Language: German
- Focus: DIY Solar, Balcony Solar (Balkonsolar), PV Self-Build
- Author: Tom (certified installer with ESTI NIV Art. 14 license since April 2025)
- Main Job: Nine Internet Solutions AG (https://nine.ch)

### Services (Angebot)
- Planning support for DIY PV installations
- Material consulting
- Tips and guidance through to connection and commissioning
- Support for self-builders in Switzerland

### Topics Covered
- Photovoltaic self-build projects
- Balcony solar systems (Balkonsolar)
- Energy calculations and visualizations
- Energy saving tips
- Equipment comparisons (Fronius, Huawei, etc.)
- Swiss regulations (NIV Art. 14)
- ZEV (Zusammenschluss zum Eigenverbrauch)
